AFL Live 2 - Essendon vs. Collingwood Gameplay [HD]
------------------------------------------

Specs:
Xbox 360 Slim 
Roxio Game Capture HD Pro

------------------------------------------

Game Information:
AFL Live 2 is a sports game in the AFL series of Australian rules football video games. It was developed by Wicked Witch Software and will be released for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 on 12 September 2013.
